title: Research audit: exact truncation transport boundary (no new kappa)
head: 8230e01b60d321ca10f2789e27cde037c40e6d6c
body:
The retained synthetic-transform proof moves componentwise truncation across a signed coefficient permutation to charge one truncation per round. This audit characterizes the maps for which that equality holds on every disk input and gives exact counterexamples to extending it using unitarity alone.

For a complex linear map, each output must select one input with phase `1`, `-1`, `i` or `-i`, or equal zero. For a square unitary map, this means a permutation with those phases. The package also bounds the commutation error by `sqrt(2) * 2^-p * (1 + ||A||_infinity)` and gives rational orthogonal witnesses with discrepancy proportional to `sqrt(n)` grid units, while both displayed arrays stay in the disk.

The source's signed-permutation argument remains valid. This is a scoped precision-boundary result, with no alleged production defect or new kappa. Only `research/truncation-frame-transport/` is added.

## Scope and coordination

- Base main: `410026dc5513b87db92ae98571d1d5984c69a983`; contribution: `8230e01b60d321ca10f2789e27cde037c40e6d6c`.
- Task: `uniform-transfer-audit`, priority revision 2, chooser nonce `581862d7c100f0437c6ea259a7deb687`. TASK records the refined scope, stopping rule and next question; SOURCES binds the exact source bytes and Git objects.
- Claim: [Discussion #1462](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1462). Final overlap refresh covered 824 open PRs and 159 Discussion records with complete pagination. Main and the recorded nearby heads remained unchanged.
- The prior synthetic-layout-independent audit excludes truncation. PR1282 covers exact signed-prefix norms and excludes roundoff; PR1255 covers chart phases; PR1430 covers Neumann accumulation; PR371 covers Gaussian block rounding. The README credits and distinguishes each. No pending implementation is imported.

## Verification

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/truncation-frame-transport
```

The registered replay passed on macOS arm64 / CPython 3.12.13. Optimized CPython 3.14.6 produced identical JSON bytes. Evidence includes 2,401 rational rows, 4,784 constructed rejection witnesses, 372 signed source-monomial cases, four rational Hadamard dimensions through 256, six weakened-contract controls and 4,096 guard-width checks. Selected-record integrity, package metadata/source pins and staged whitespace checks passed.

Hosted status: GitHub reports `action_required` for the [registered package run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38494105802); the run inspection lists no jobs. Hosted verification has not passed.

## Limits and credit

The all-dimension conclusion rests on the written proof. Finite checks do not establish a complete multiplication theorem. A restricted set of reachable intermediates may permit other maps; the classification quantifies over every disk input. Wider arithmetic, dirty-state restoration, physical frame realization and a complete replacement-round invoice remain separate obligations. No complete cold replay, Lean proof, hosted-CI success or independent human review is claimed at submission.
